context_for_next_testing_agent: NavTabs.jsx header overlap fix (Sep 15 2026) confirmed working. The tabs+dropdowns now scroll horizontally inside their own flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto container (.nav-scroll-x hides scrollbar); user-menu is a shrink-0 sibling outside that scroll area so it stays fully visible. SapConnectionStatus + ErpConnectionStatus badges (rendered by each page outside NavTabs) no longer get overlapped. Verified on BOM, Inventory, Admin pages at 1920 and 1366 widths, plus mobile 390.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — this iteration was verification, not RCA. Original RCA (per problem statement): the always-visible tab bar had no shrink/scroll handling and after a 3rd top-level tab with a long label ('Production Confirmation (Test)') was added, total unwrapped width exceeded available space at normal desktop widths, causing NavTabs' flex content to push into sibling SapConnectionStatus/ErpConnectionStatus badges. Fix: wrap tabs+dropdowns in flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-x-auto container so they scroll horizontally internally; move user-menu OUT of that scroll container as a shrink-0 sibling.
